capabilities: Chat with MiMo models in a sidebar with locally saved threads
Rewrite selected note text in place with a diff preview
Give the assistant vault tools to read, search, write, and edit notes
Look up public web results from text chat turns
extras: Requires Obsidian desktop v1.7.2+. Web search must be enabled in the MiMo console and incurs extra search fees. Privacy section notes that messages, images, and vault context are sent to Xiaomi servers, and the assistant can modify or trash notes. Two billing types (Token Plan tp- keys, pay-as-you-go sk- keys) with region-specific endpoints. No analytics collected; transcripts stored locally in the plugin folder.
intentEvidence: MiMo is built on top of Claudian by Yishen Tu.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in AI assistant, so using MiMo models requires leaving the vault or running separate tooling.

relations.evidence: MiMo is built on top of Claudian by Yishen Tu. Thanks for the solid foundation.
